scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/make-cli-executable.mjs
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js run AF-101 --local
scripts.agentforge: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js run --project=examples/taskboard
scripts.jira:check: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js check-jira
scripts.github:check: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js check-github
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync('.agentforge', { recursive: true, force: true });"
